product.description: Despre Leonardo da Vinci s-au scris nenumărate volume. Cartea lui Michael White ne oferă însă o perspectivă cu totul nouă asupra activității acestui om universal al Renașterii, analizând preocupările sale științifice, de la arhitectură, anatomie, inginerie militară și civilă până la optică și astronomie. Sunt detaliate aspecte cunoscute și mai puțin cunoscute din viața lui Leonardo, cum ar fi copilaria nefericitș, ucenicia în atelierul lui Verrocchio din Florența, homosexualitatea sa asumată, ori relația cu importanți mecena ai epocii (Lorenzo Magnificul, Ludovico Sforza, Cesare Borgia), precum și rivalitatea cu Michelangelo. Autorul reușește să pună în lumină nu numai geniul artistic al lui Da Vinci, ci și geniul său de inventator. Michael White a scris o relatare ușor de citit a vieții și a realizărilor științifice ale lui Da Vinci. Library Journal Într-o manieră actuală, White a reușit o încântătoare operă de prezentare a lui Leonardo da Vinci și a epocii sale. Publishers Weekly

# Leonardo da Vinci: Biography of a Genius

Dive into an unparalleled portrait of the ultimate Renaissance mind with *Leonardo da Vinci*. Often described as a universal man, Leonardo's life inspired countless biographies, but Michael Whiteâs work offers something entirely new. This comprehensive biography goes far beyond just his famous paintings, painting a vivid picture of his extraordinary breadth of geniusâfrom art and science to engineering and human experience.

For readers seeking an insightful understanding of the Renaissance era and its most brilliant mind, *Leonardo da Vinci: A Biography of a Genius* is essential reading.

## Unveiling the Mind of the Renaissance Master

Michael Whiteâs acclaimed book presents an accessible yet deeply detailed look at Leonardo's incredible body of work. It treats him not just as an artist, but as a polymath whose curiosity spanned nearly every field of human knowledge.

The biography meticulously explores the multifaceted genius of Da Vinci:

**ð Scientific and Intellectual Pursuits:**
Discover how his scientific mind operated. The book analyzes his pioneering efforts in areas like architecture, anatomy, civil and military engineering, optics, and astronomy. White illuminates not only his genius as an artist but also his groundbreaking achievements as an inventor.

**ð¤ Personal Life and Historical Context:**
Beyond the famous masterpieces, Michael White delves into the private life of Leonardo da Vinci. The narrative includes sensitive details such as his difficult childhood, his apprenticeship in Verrocchio's Florentine workshop, his acknowledged homosexuality, and his complex relationships with powerful figures of the age, including Lorenzo Magnificent, Ludovico Sforza, and Cesare Borgia. It even explores his professional rivalry with Michelangelo.

## Why This Biography Stands Apart

*Leonardo da Vinci: A Biography of a Genius* is praised for its ability to synthesize profound historical research into an engaging, easy-to-read narrative. As noted by *Library Journal*, White has created an enchanting and modern presentation that brings Leonardo's world back to life. You will gain both admiration for his artistic skill and deep respect for his intellectual depth.

***

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Will this book cover only art history?**
No. While it extensively covers his artistic contributions, the focus is on presenting him as a polymath. The biography dedicates significant time to his scientific inquiries, engineering designs, and anatomical studies.

**Is the content too academic or difficult to read?**
The author excels at making complex topics accessible. According to reviews, Michael White crafts an "engaging" reading experience that preserves factual rigor without sacrificing readability.
